notes: Each series is one (provider, metric, aggregation) definition held by this system for the authenticated user. Absence of a series or of records means no accessible records here; it does not indicate inactivity, no device wear, or denied authorization.
local_days_with_records counts distinct local dates (requested timezone) containing at least one record start. It is not a coverage ratio or a completeness guarantee.
Only records starting inside the requested window (at most 366 local days) are counted; older history is not examined by this call.
provider is the acquisition channel, not a verified single device.
